name: Samukawa Chizuru
source:
Reiji's mother, a full-time housewife. She strives to be a devoted wife and mother, protecting her home and son in place of her frequently transferred husband... 

yet she has a somewhat childish and absent-minded side.

[From [url=http://highseen.pink/gpower/product/dgp_pro18.html#chara]official site[/url]]
